concepts.hook: Bitter office coffee? Check these three variables.
Stop changing everything in your coffee at once.
That meeting may be changing your brew.

beats.narration: Bitter office coffee? Check these three variables.
beats.visual_request: Close vertical shot of a fictional unbranded coffee cup in a clean office pantry.
beats.audio_note: Warm voice; music low under speech.

beats.narration: First, use the same coffee-to-water ratio each time.
beats.visual_request: Measured scoop and water vessel on a cream counter, teal and amber accents.

beats.narration: Second, let freshly boiled water cool slightly before brewing.
beats.visual_request: Fictional kettle beside a timer, no brand marks, clear lower-third area.

beats.narration: Third, watch contact time so an interruption does not extend the brew.
beats.visual_request: Phone timer beside a simple brewer in an office pantry, fictional hands only.

beats.narration: Change one variable, taste, then adjust. Save this checklist.
beats.visual_request: Three-item checklist card in teal, amber, and cream; no generated logo text.

claims_ledger.text: Overly hot water can contribute to bitterness.
Longer contact time may intensify bitterness.

rights_and_disclosure_notes: Record provenance for every generated or placeholder asset.
